messages.content: {"task": "Translate EVERY supplied row into Russian. Return JSON only: {\"rows\":[{\"source_id\":\"exact supplied id\",\"target\":\"complete Russian translation\"}]}. Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 208, "heading": "VII STRATÉGIE ET TACTIQUE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u208-r0030", "target": "— 440.", "source_sha256": "cbdcd234a1572d1d92d8ec6bb65f7546df986636a1e25a72fb4ed0b2ca53958f", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u208-r0030", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "cbdcd234a1572d1d92d8ec6bb65f7546df986636a1e25a72fb4ed0b2ca53958f"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u208-r0031", "target": "— Хорошо, ты девка с головой.", "source_sha256": "c3e1e92265e80f61d5d62d71d6b3b3b04b2354ca5463a994065e31b3de76f868", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u208-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "564058d104b16cdd1e1fa3277c9d0a623fe6cf305bead6b333349576be9dac2d"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 8, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u208-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "La fille regarda hardiment son père, et, montrant les chaussures qu’elle avait aux pieds :", "sha256": "4c5b7a567b37d9611bb5c40fc54dcd40f28141f65fcb55f9f1ffec703bbe5ced", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Une fille d’esprit, c’est possible, mais je dis que je ne mettrai plus ces souliers-là, et que je n’en veux plus, pour la santé d’abord, et pour la propreté ensuite. Je ne connais rien de plus agaçant que des semelles qui jutent et qui font ghi, ghi, ghi, tout le long du chemin. J’aime mieux aller nu-pieds.", "sha256": "8651a8393ca095f2d21da387f0088910483cb1609ec4cfc640365d4f71719fef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu as raison, répondit le père d’un ton de douceur qui contrastait avec la rudesse de la jeune fille, mais c’est qu’on ne te laisserait pas entrer dans les églises. Il faut que les pauvres aient des souliers. On ne va pas pieds nus chez le bon Dieu, ajouta-t-il amèrement. Puis revenant à l’objet qui le préoccupait : — Et tu es sûre, là, sûre qu’il vient ?", "sha256": "12a69dec5f76045a2744313183bdcce728bf4e49c1a00272f96eed751b86a184", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il est derrière mes talons, dit-elle.", "sha256": "02ba0107f09ca90f5adef76b5fb64cd3d09d43e1053ec035e778b97344669d22", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’homme se dressa. Il y avait une sorte d’illumination sur son visage.", "sha256": "f17337799cbc0eed412f551f73591f8add744a59f3e9fd3c92c1cd42f1618f3b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ma femme ! cria-t-il, tu entends. Voilà le philanthrope. Éteins le feu.", "sha256": "e11537b17645f643aeab55b1eeebc47cf70536eedd0ce9060356f9203ac8b05c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "La mère stupéfaite ne bougea pas.", "sha256": "e251d7969027bfdb35a305688f6678db35f52f3107931b35ea326173274f762c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le père, avec l’agilité d’un saltimbanque, saisit un pot égueulé qui était sur la cheminée et jeta de l’eau sur les tisons.", "sha256": "7a0612cc11587506b2199ddd0e135f2e9d757166cad7024171b55153efdabfe8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis s’adressant à sa fille aînée :", "sha256": "4ef246cbd0c878c751be510c54186d08bf0b99d302e29b8da875dcc8a1d9a826", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Toi ! dépaille la chaise !", "sha256": "c0cdc86f5246a3cb3d58a0f6fa1a0ac20d029ed7d882aa0cc915b45291b849fb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sa fille ne comprenait point.", "sha256": "35e33745f9bb1d708a72d52ee99b24a270fa420a70b7020681dcbd4ae30defbe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il empoigna la chaise et d’un coup de talon il en fit une chaise dépaillée. Sa jambe passa au travers.", "sha256": "2463e99d14230679b01389cb255abacbc0e50922515b2d391000a3d569145a80", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "Tout en retirant la jambe, il demanda à sa fille :", "sha256": "e4008076c3372abdeead70d4f246049a776197d66966296530bdc87e5eccfc31", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Fait-il froid ?", "sha256": "a5d6f25acf0c63833e87998b8340476191d187db91460f8b572be31c0dd1e7dd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Très froid. Il neige.", "sha256": "d6a97ff00579251b81cb8980a73e077bf59fc7dd8bb1ed049e8dfdc6941b3c5c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le père se tourna vers la cadette qui était sur le grabat près de la fenêtre et lui cria d’une voix tonnante :", "sha256": "93aacb3433851fdd436754593db03cec6ac9a03402679d45a0d64b560f31b241", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vite ! à bas du lit, fainéante ! tu ne feras donc jamais rien ! Casse un carreau !", "sha256": "b109836361b02c78b9049e311f348ff87efaadc15bad2b6f8db1dc9a8cba8b12", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "La petite se jeta à bas du lit en frissonnant.", "sha256": "14de4cdf99ca9e9f79695776babf4ca5eade2c38e9fd3521b9deae3e9f905c66", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Casse un carreau ! reprit-il.", "sha256": "0bb9fd41852bcfe43b5494bb988f63d3d664498f5bdc1a7202d6c292ad4b60de", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’enfant demeura interdite.", "sha256": "957b5638c32632d849be5cedf654976e010c9a8a3d35d3a62283fdb2c1d49454", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "— M’entends-tu ? répéta le père, je te dis de casser un carreau !", "sha256": "f308588b475e20af8f7432bbd08c88374f8fac16f25c3cbe8cf28a3bb3dd462b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’enfant, avec une sorte d’obéissance terrifiée, se dressa sur la pointe du pied, et donna un coup de poing dans un carreau. La vitre se brisa et tomba à grand bruit.", "sha256": "82a2a9db200f6ef06ace1490f6d4cce81aef6ee3e4d3de17ad6a3576d2fca665", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Bien, dit le père.", "sha256": "f8690704608d132d7f1d0ce61a1c23b7071572b7a8105399f99033bf314b2e17", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il était grave et brusque. Son regard parcourait rapidement tous les recoins du galetas.", "sha256": "2aea527395c54ff990a6e93fa3c430b3928b973ef554b0be5ca2e9b9952f65bc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "On eût dit un général qui fait les derniers préparatifs au moment où la bataille va commencer.", "sha256": "716217e4501288113c598c6fcc30c0cf762d4f91d7be38be497905bc7e48aeb8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "La mère, qui n’avait pas encore dit un mot, se souleva et demanda d’une voix lente et sourde et dont les paroles semblaient sortir comme figées :", "sha256": "8eb9527cbbd8986e4693408a662aa46c351b34dd532afb112d53077e0cfa7f0c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Chéri, qu’est-ce que tu veux faire ?", "sha256": "4cc1cd55c5af88e7e069c7d3571c583871d6b32b29134c07105af0f4ce97c407", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mets-toi au lit, répondit l’homme.", "sha256": "46c0edf5632f442d0c9affd5880b51a3ea226911a25d04f2de6f493a6618435b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’intonation n’admettait pas de délibération. La mère obéit et se jeta lourdement sur un des grabats.", "sha256": "fdc6cb83e699f814b6717ed4fb4bc0634355ed61a1d92772d8e3c74d343af1b5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "Cependant on entendait un sanglot dans un coin.", "sha256": "ebbd7865617b91c9effac13fa5fee20c41586f830dc3de63ca8c26a3d07ee7f4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Qu’est-ce que c’est ? cria le père.", "sha256": "b975c6317e9a682aa8bb8a469947bcb1c1d1e88ab576d9e3da9656144f7159d5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u208-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "La fille cadette, sans sortir de l’ombre où elle s’était blottie, montra son poing ensanglanté. En brisant la vitre elle s’était blessée ; elle s’en était allée près du grabat de sa mère, et elle pleurait silencieusement.", "sha256": "b441e2c0589950a32dc13f1473894b8e3636e0a40951c84d1e77c4d618681b2d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
